## Summary
`beast-civilization v0.6.0` ("The Omniscient Hyper-Colony") is a zero-dependency polyglot bare-metal Agent Civilization, Post-Quantum Colony, Trinity Autonomous Forge (OS Microkernels + 4-Layer Chimera LLMs + Bare-Metal A-Life Worlds), MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 Server, & Evolutionary Compute Substrate unifying `nagisanzenin/{INIT-Agent,nonhuman,engram,effortmining,nagi,strictlybetter,crucible,math-first}`, `temm1e-labs/{temm1e,temrust}`, `tsotchke/{eshkol,moonlab,quantum_geometric_tensor,quantum_rng,rosette-wire,libirrep,PINN,spin_based_neural_network,tensorcore}`, `0thernes/{autophage,cellular-engine-omega,cellulogonic-mecha,noetic-organism-omega,planaria,alife-singularity-omega-package}`, and MIT/ICLR 2026 Cache-to-Cache / Swarm Telepathy across **Zig `0.17.1`**, **Rust `1.94.1` (8 crates)**, **CRuby `3.4.9`/Prism/YARV**, **C11 (`12 / 12` live native DLLs)**, **QEMU `11.1.0` Ring-0 booted AI microkernels**, **Win32 Kernel Job Objects**, **NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti `sm_12.0` 5-Kernel PTX + `10.17 GB/s` Pinned Async VRAM Paging**, **Eshkol Tri-Mode AD (`0.00e0` err)**, and **60 Pure Lean 4 `v4.35.0` Theorems** (`296 / 300 = 98.7%` agent matrix live-verified).
